questions.question_text: What name is given to the perimeter of a circle — the distance all the way around it?

options.why: Named the distance straight across the circle instead of the distance around it.
Named a part of the boundary instead of the complete boundary.
Named the distance from the centre out to the boundary instead of the distance around it.

questions.solution_text:
The perimeter of a circle is the whole curve that forms its boundary.
It is the circumference.
